gloss: to devise cleverly; to use ingenuity

definitions.gloss: to devise cleverly; to use ingenuity; to put thought and effort into
definitions.explanation: To apply creativity and careful thought to come up with something effective or inventive. Implies dedicated effort in the planning or design of something.

examples.japanese: {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare food with creative ingenuity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らして⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飽|あ}きさせない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher uses ingenuity in class to keep students from getting bored.

examples.japanese: ⟦デザイナー→デザイナー：05061_dezainaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}→来場者：19023_raijousha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The cleverly devised exhibition by the designer received high praise from visitors.

notes:
A set expression combining ⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧ (ingenuity, device) with ⟦{凝|こ}らす→凝らす：08224_korasu⟧ (to concentrate, to elaborate). The verb ⟦{凝|こ}らす→凝らす：08224_korasu⟧ conveys putting concentrated effort into something, so the expression emphasizes dedicated creative thinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ — creatively prepared food
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧ — ingeniously crafted design
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧ — a well-thought-out lesson
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした⟦{演出|えんしゅつ}→演出：04460_enshutsu⟧ — cleverly devised production/staging

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工夫|くふう}する→工夫する：22180_kufuusuru⟧ — to devise, to think up (simpler; less emphasis on elaborate effort)
- ⟦{趣向|しゅこう}→趣向：24895_shukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{凝|こ}らす→凝らす：08224_korasu⟧ — to exercise one's ingenuity (similar structure; focuses on creative taste)
- ⟦{知恵|ちえ}を{絞|しぼ}る→知恵を絞る：18094_chiewoshiboru⟧ — to rack one's brains (emphasizes the difficulty of thinking)

USAGE:
Often appears in the past participle form {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした as a modifier before nouns, describing something that is the product of careful creative effort.
